component Atlas cluster mongodbatlas_advanced_cluster.main
component Cloudflare queue cloudflare_queue.jobs
component Cloudflare zone cloudflare_zone.site
component R2 bucket cloudflare_r2_bucket.uploads
component Vercel Blob store vercel_blob_store.assets
component Vercel project vercel_project.web
component Worker cloudflare_workers_script.api
component Worker cloudflare_workers_script.worker
connection cloudflare_queue.jobs -> cloudflare_workers_script.worker [triggers]
connection cloudflare_workers_script.api -> cloudflare_queue.jobs [uses]
connection cloudflare_workers_script.api -> cloudflare_r2_bucket.uploads [uses]
connection cloudflare_workers_script.api -> mongodbatlas_advanced_cluster.main [uses]
connection cloudflare_zone.site -> cloudflare_workers_script.api [routes to]
connection cloudflare_zone.site -> vercel_project.web [routes to]
connection vercel_project.web -> vercel_blob_store.assets [uses]
